dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: If you've got any work planned for this evening, I politely decline.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I just finished some extremely grisly work, so I at least need to give myself a little break first.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: What kind of grisly? I intend to keep that to myself. Nothing to be happy about, that's for sure. The less you know, the better.
